title: Scalability Patterns & Caching Strategies
description: Caching topologies, invalidate patterns, load balancing algorithms, rate limiting, and asynchronous processing.
content:
# Scalability Patterns & Caching Strategies

## 1. Caching Topologies & Invalidation
- **Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading)**: Application reads cache; on miss, loads from DB and updates cache.
- **Write-Through**: Application writes to cache; cache synchronously writes to DB.
- **Write-Behind (Write-Back)**: Application writes to cache; cache asynchronously flushes to DB in batches.
- **Refresh-Ahead**: Cache pre-emptively refreshes keys before TTL expiration based on access patterns.

## 2. Load Balancing & Reverse Proxy
- **Layer 4 (L4) Load Balancing**: Operates at TCP/UDP level. Fast, low overhead.
- **Layer 7 (L7) Load Balancing**: Operates at HTTP/HTTPS level. Enables URL routing, SSL termination, rate-limiting.
